entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. You're speaking with Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I'm... well, I'm just so disappointed. I bought the new VeloBand Cadence Sensor and it's not working at all.
Oh no, I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I can help properly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a fault. It feels like the device is just broken. I've charged it completely, but it won't sync with the VeloFit app no matter what I do. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for this... I feel so let down.
I can certainly understand your frustration, especially when you're excited to use a new product for your training. It sounds like you believe the unit itself might be defective. Is that correct?
Yes, I think it is. I was hoping I could just return it. Honestly, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work. This whole situation is just so upsetting.

I understand completely. I've pulled up your account, and I see the band was delivered 13 days ago. For this specific device, our return window for a refund is 10 days. However, what you're describing—that it's not working and won't sync—is different. That falls under our product warranty.

The best and fastest way to resolve this is to connect you with our Technical Support team. They are equipped to troubleshoot the syncing issue or, if they confirm the item is defective, they can process a warranty replacement for you immediately.
Oh... so I can't just get a refund? I've always had such a simple time with VeloFit before. I'm just worried this will be a big hassle.

I assure you, it's the most direct path to a solution. Since the device seems to be broken, the tech team can get you a working one much faster than a return and re-purchase process would take. I can do a warm transfer right now so you won't have to wait on hold again. Would that be okay?
Okay... yes, I suppose if they can get me a new one that works, that would be good. I'd appreciate the transfer. Thank you.
Of course. I'm glad we have a path forward for you. Please hold one moment while I connect you to Technical Support. They'll take great care of you. Thanks for your patience today.
